results.name: Mavi New York (Mavi New York, Inc)
results.registry: NYC Department of Buildings license and registration records (NYC Open Data dataset 'DOB License Info', t8hj-ruu2, rows updated 2026-11-18)
results.note: Checked 2026-11-19. The DOB record for MAVI NEW YORK, INC (Long Island City, company phone 718-874-3805) shows General Contractor no. 626466 with status EXPIRED. The company's own website still cites 'NYC DOB General Contractor License #626466' and calls the company an authorized distributor and installer of commercial toilet partitions (https://mavinewyork.com/). The dataset has no expiration date field. Confirm on DOB NOW public license search (www.nyc.gov/dobnow) or ask the installer for current registration before they can be Verified. Under the area rule, GC registration is needed only for permitted projects. Partition installs may not always need a permit, so an expired GC registration may not rule them out. The job coordinator should check this.
